heading: In 2022, Tom Hanks launched his own nonprofit coffee brand for war veterans; for the past 4 years, the company has helped hundreds of military families
author: TOI Entertainment Desk / etimes.in / Updated: Sep 21, 2026, 11:44 IST
paragraphs: In 2022, beloved star Tom Hanks, who is best known for his roles in ‘Toy Story’ and ‘Forrest Gump,' started a new kind of nonprofit project that has been helping military families for the past four years! Hanks officially launched his very own coffee brand under the nonprofit model, meaning none of the proceeds earned by the coffee will go to him; instead, they will be distributed to many military families across the nation.In 2022, Tom Hanks started his own coffee label to help war veteransInitially known as Hanx Coffee and now called Hanks for Our Troops, the coffee brand has a curated collection for coffee lovers
It offers ground coffee and single-serve pods in various roasts and flavours

Called “coffee with purpose," Hanks connected his brand with all kinds of veteran services that operate across America to provide funds and create awareness.On the official website of the coffee brand, the ‘story’ behind it all is written about how “At HANKS, we’re on a mission to create goods that do good

We honour the patriotism and service of our veterans and their families by giving all profits to organisations that will provide them with critical support and resources.” They also listed all of the organisations they work with and help by providing as much financial support as possible
These organisations work in different ways and sectors to help war veterans and their families, including employment, mental health resources, education, and assistance for military communities

People can order the coffee from the official website, though it is also available in-store at a popular chain.Hanks is not the only celebrity who has started similar initiatives to help the community around them

Paul Newman started his own salad dressing firm called ‘Newman's Own’ after he used to make it mainly for his family and neighbours, donating 100% of its profits to charity.About Tom Hanks and his philanthropic effortsOver the years, Tom Hanks has contributed continuously to all kinds of efforts and initiatives to give back to the community
He is also a campaign chair for the Hidden Heroes initiative, which raises awareness about officials who tend to injured and wounded war veterans at home and raises funds for their everyday resources
He also served as the official national campaign chairman for the World War II Memorial campaign in Washington, DC, and raised millions of dollars for the campaign
Other than that, Hanks has also invested in medical research and funding initiatives, with him and his wife, Rita Wilson, serving as Honorary Chairs for the Women’s Cancer Research Fund (WCRF)

The organisation works towards raising funds for innovative cancer research and early detection.On the work front, Hanks last lent his voice to the hit animated film, ‘Toy Story 5.' Other than that, he appeared on screen in 2025 in ‘John Candy: I Like Me.'
